title: capsella oviculata
intro: Capsella oviculata, commonly known as shepherds purse, is a flowering plant in the mustard family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can aid in relieving colds, coughs, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of Capsella oviculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, killing bacteria, and thinning mucus, making it a popular natural remedy for respiratory issues and skin conditions.
